i.norm: processBitVector decodes a long bit vector back into the matching enum constants: bit N (counting from the least significant bit) selects the enum constant with ordinal N. Locale.FilteringMode has 5 constants, so only bits 0-4 can map to a constant; any higher bits in the vector are ignored. The value 2800 (binary 101011110000) only has one of its set bits in the 0-4 range (bit 4), so exactly one enum constant is decoded.
